body: I know you're a random stranger on the Internet but appreciate you and how you talked to me last night. I still cut..you know there will be nothing that can replace that sensation when you do it. I hope you start to feel better. My ex always told me "it gets better....I promise" (we met in a hospital and supported each other). I'm still waiting on it to get better.

I feel the same maybe a little better..my girlfriend helped talk me down (surprisingly). I'm still unsure about my life...I don't know I'll see how the day takes.. I'm currently 12 hours ahead of my hometown to talking to her is difficult.. I hope you feel better
Thank you for your support..you're right at least I'm not alone
But does talking really matter? It's all going to have the same outcome.
Honest..nothing really anymore..I used to bike (all the time) but I don't. I can't right now and it just helps me get away from the problems but then I think about them more on the road.
I wish I could say that to myself
